name: repro-pinch-zoom
description: Owner report: trackpad zoom and pan are broken. Pinches on the fiducial with a screenshot after every few events, so the pixel witness can say what one magnify event does, how far the image point under the cursor drifts through a 40-event pinch, whether the picture moves in the three seconds after the pinch while the sharp render lands, whether a second pinch compounds, how a two-finger pan moves the picture, and how far it can be pushed past its borders.

steps.note: a single magnify event of +0.03 at fit

steps.name: rest-0
steps.note: the three seconds after the pinch, while the sharp render lands
three seconds after the pinch there is a picture on screen, not a blank
a second pinch must continue from the first
push the picture far past its top-left corner
the picture can be panned past its edge (app's own geometry)
the same pinch at real speed, for timing
a 0.67 s pinch has been handled within 1.2 s
the main thread never stalls longer than 100 ms during a pinch
after the pinch the app answers again within a quarter second
the picture visibly follows the pinch (30 Hz watch of the screen)
(branches that count them) the pinches arrived as native magnify events
(branches that count them) none came through the fallback

witness.note: one +0.03 magnify makes the picture 1.03x as wide
the image point under the cursor stays under it through the 40-event pinch
no jump between consecutive captures of the pinch
a 2x pinch doubles what is on screen
the picture is on screen in all four captures after the pinch
no movement in the 3 s after the pinch while the settle lands
no change of size in the 3 s after the pinch
the app's own idea of the picture's rectangle matches the pixels
the second pinch compounds from where the first ended
a two-finger pan moves the picture by the fingers' distance

overscroll stops with about a quarter of the pane still covered
after a 2x pinch from fit at real speed the picture is about twice as wide as the 771 pt it was
